newsitem.title: UK: Air London sees profits taking off.
newsitem.headline: Air London sees profits taking off.

text.p: Air London International Plc said its profits for the year to July 31 1996 will be significantly higher than the 1.7 million stg forecast.

The international aircraft charter broker said sales and profits in the second half of the year continued to benefit from improved business from established clients, a higher level of fee-only business, which improves margins, plus a positive contribution from its French unit Air Partner International.
The group said it expects to publish annual results on October 31.
Air London's shares soared after the profit forecast upgrade, rising 34 pence to 166.5 pence by 0901 GMT.
